text.text_excerpt: As many times as I went to the old thrift store in this spot, I can't believe how much stuff is crammed into the new Rouses. To be clear, this is not a full grocery but it is a great spot to pick up a couple of essentials or some party food... which is what I did. Prepared foods are definitely the focus. I had some family come town and we had a last minute cookout and I was in charge of apps. Stopping in the new Rouses was perfect, I picked up deviled eggs and chips, salsa & guac and crawfish pies. And of course beer and cookies. Since it was the first weekend open, they were more than fully staffed and there were tons of staff around greeting customers and offering assistance. The parkin...

This is new Rouses location on Freret Street. Marc Ardoin (a little biased we went to high school together) and his team are fantastic and eager to help you navigate the new store. While this is a smaller location than most Rouses stores, it is super nice and has a great cafe/ coffee bar.

New Rouses is bomb!!! Great selection of vegan food and it's nicely arranged. Smaller than some other Rouses but has the awesome Freret Faire Cafe which is so cool!! Incogmeato chikn nuggets were on sale for a great price so I got two!! 10/10 highly recommend!
